pairs.why: B's navy engine is lifted by big saturated red (cab roof, wheels, pilot) and a large cool blue sky, like the real bus and bike cards, while A is mostly dark navy on a large orange desert, so it feels more muted and warm-biased.

A's teal saucer is a fully chromatic hero set against a warm yellow-orange background, the same hero-vs-complement hue split as the real cards (orange on purple, pink on cyan, blue on pink), while B's body is neutral silver with little chroma.
